title: M.Tech Admission Requirements and Eligibility - KITCOEK
text:
M.TECH ADMISSION REQUIREMENTS — KITCOEK

KITCOEK offers M.Tech (Master of Technology) postgraduate programs in multiple departments. Here are the complete admission requirements:

ELIGIBILITY FOR M.TECH ADMISSION
- Candidates must hold a B.Tech / B.E. degree in the relevant engineering branch.
- Minimum 50% aggregate marks in the qualifying degree (45% for reserved categories).
- Valid GATE (Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering) score is preferred and mandatory for AICTE scholarship.
- Admission through DTE Maharashtra CAP (Centralized Admission Process) or direct institute-level admission.
- Candidates without GATE score may be admitted through institute-level entrance test / merit in qualifying exam.

M.TECH PROGRAMS OFFERED AT KITCOEK
1. M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering Design — Mechanical Engineering Department
2. M.Tech in Biochemical Engineering and Biotechnology — Biotechnology Department
3. M.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering — CSE Department
4. M.Tech in Civil Engineering — Civil Engineering Department
5. M.Tech in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering — E&TC Department

APPLICATION PROCESS
1. Register on DTE Maharashtra portal (dtemaharashtra.gov.in) for CAP rounds.
2. Upload required documents: B.Tech marksheets, GATE scorecard (if available), caste certificate, domicile certificate.
3. Participate in online document verification and counselling rounds.
4. Alternatively, apply directly through KITCOEK for institute-level seats.

DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
- B.Tech/B.E. degree certificate and marksheets (all semesters)
- GATE scorecard (if applicable)
- Category/Caste certificate (for reserved categories)
- Domicile/Nativity certificate
- Aadhar card, passport-size photographs
- Migration certificate

AICTE SCHOLARSHIP FOR M.TECH
- Students with valid GATE score admitted to AICTE-approved PG programs are eligible for AICTE scholarship.
- Scholarship amount: As per AICTE norms.
